item.title: Bulletin updated at 17:50 HKT 19/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a southerly airstream, it will be warm and humid with showers over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to Guangdong areas in the latter part of this week. Showers will increase and there will be thunderstorms over the region.

Date/Month: 20/03 (Monday)
Wind: East force 4, becoming southeast force 3 later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches. Misty in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 20 - 24 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 21/03 (Tuesday)

Weather: Sunny intervals and one or two showers. Misty in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 22 - 27 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
